steps.code:
# Now let's advance through the queue until we reach a liked song.
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print(f"Starting at song_id {current_song['song_id']}")

# Loop to advance until we hit a liked song
for step in range(1, 20):  # safety limit
    if current_song['song_id'] in liked_ids:
        print(f"Reached liked song at step {step-1}: song_id {current_song['song_id']}")
        break
    # Advance to next song
    result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Step {step}: next_song returned {result}")
    # Get the new current song
    current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"  Now at song_id {current_song['song_id']} - {current_song['title']}")
else:
    print("Did not find liked song within limit")
